justifications.goal_fidelity: seven of eight production call sites now pass run_dir (dispatch.py:6222/9900/10031, promotion.py:3795/5583, recovery.py:867/3052), the prior review's blocking miss at recovery.py:867 is closed, and the one caller that does not (recovery.py:7441) legitimately has no run directory and names its project instead.
